description: This file contains row-level security policies and access controls for various tables in a learning management system, including profiles, lessons, quizzes, assignments, and quiz submissions.

methods.name: auth.uid()
methods.description: Function to retrieve the current authenticated user's ID, used to enforce user-specific policies.

calls: coalesce((select role from public.profiles p where p.user_id = auth.uid()), '')
exists (select 1 from public.assignments a where a.lesson_id = lessons.id and a.assignee_user = auth.uid())
exists (select 1 from public.assignments a where a.quiz_id = quizzes.id and a.assignee_user = auth.uid())
